mapper.select: select n.id, n.reply_id as replyId, n.actor_uuid as actorUuid, u.nickname as actorNickname, n.creation_type as creationType, n.creation_id as creationId, n.creation_snippet as creationSnippet, n.content_snippet as contentSnippet, n.is_read as isRead, n.created_at as createdAt from reply_notification n left join user u on u.uuid = n.actor_uuid left join creation_comment c on n.creation_type = 'COMMENT' and c.id = n.creation_id left join creation_reply r on n.creation_type = 'REPLY' and r.id = n.creation_id where n.receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} order by n.created_at desc
mapper.update: update reply_notification set is_read = 1, read_at = now(), updated_at = now() where receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and is_read = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from reply_notification where receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and is_read = 0
